 AI Summary Cooking gas users face potential refill roadblocks if mandatory identity verifications remain incomplete alongside upcoming monthly fuel price revisions. Check which digital portals allow households to complete quick biometric updates before booking.
 Advertisement Remove Ad + Follow on Google Add as preferred source LPG consumers may need to check their Aadhaar e-KYC status and cylinder prices before booking a refill from November 1.
 Consumers using Indane, Bharatgas and HP Gas should check whether their Aadhaar e-KYC is complete. The verification requirement came into effect on October 1, 2026. Those who have already completed the process do not need to repeat it.

They can check their status through their gas provider's app, the official My LPG website or their local distributor.
 How to complete Aadhaar e-KYC for LPG 
 Consumers can complete the process through their gas provider's mobile app. Indane users can use IndianOil One, Bharatgas users can use Hello BPCL, and HP Gas users can use HP Pay.
 After logging in, they need to select the Aadhaar e-KYC option and follow the instructions for face authentication. Consumers can also contact their local gas distributor for help.
 Will LPG cylinder prices change from November 1? 
 Oil marketing companies review commercial LPG prices on the first day of every month. The new rates for November are expected to be announced on November 1.
 In Delhi, a 19-kg commercial LPG cylinder cost ₹2,810 in October. These cylinders are commonly used by hotels, restaurants and other businesses. Domestic LPG prices have remained unchanged since June 7, 2026. A standard 14.2-kg household cylinder currently costs ₹942 in Delhi.
 How will the rules affect your household budget? 
 Advertisement Remove Ad If domestic LPG prices increase, households may have to spend more on cooking fuel. Consumers who are eligible for subsidies should also ensure that their required e-KYC verification is complete to avoid problems with refill bookings.
 If commercial cylinder prices rise, people who regularly eat at restaurants or order food may also see higher prices.
